walkthroughs.body_html:
Sea walls — reflect waves; £6,000/m
Groynes — trap sand; cause downdrift erosion
Rip-rap — rock armour; cheap and effective
Gabions — wire cages of rocks; ugly but cheap

All have costs vs benefits.

Beach nourishment — pump sand from offshore
Dune regeneration — plant marram grass
Managed retreat — let low land flood naturally
Cliff regrading — reduce slope angle

Soft methods work with nature.

Groynes seem great — they trap sand updrift.

But they starve the next beach of sediment:
• Downdrift erosion speeds up
• Conflict between neighbouring towns

This causes terminal groyne syndrome.

options: They cause downdrift erosion
They are illegal
They cannot trap sand
They are very expensive
Longshore drift is the rising of sea level over time.
Sand moves along the beach because tides pull it sideways.
Hurricanes form when two cold fronts collide above the ocean.
The zigzag movement of sediment along a coast caused by waves approaching at an angle (swash up the beach) and gravity returning water perpendicular (backwash).

mcqs.q: Why do tropical cyclones only form over warm tropical oceans?
options: They need sea surface temperatures above ~27 degrees C to a depth of 50m to provide energy through evaporation, plus enough Coriolis effect (away from the equator) to spin.
Hurricanes form when two cold fronts collide above the ocean.
Hydraulic action is when the river dissolves rocks chemically.
Hurricanes form wherever there are strong winds over the sea.

mcqs.q: What is hydraulic action in a river?
options: Hydraulic action is when the river dissolves rocks chemically.
The force of moving water itself compressing air into cracks in the river bank or bed, weakening rock until pieces break off — no sediment needed.
Hurricanes form when two cold fronts collide above the ocean.
Hydraulic action is when rocks in the river smash into each other.
